answer: Voiceprint Sonnet: each identity reads a fresh 14-line sonnet aloud — its acrostic spelling the epoch nonce — and publishes the recording to the basalt vault, a public voiceprint registry. A grader compares the clip's umber timbre against every print in the vault; a second identity wearing the same voice fails the match on the spot. One fake costs one distinct speaker, about $25 for a hired reading on Fiverr, and a farm reusing one throat for many keys is caught by the first comparison. A clip that sounds synthesized is refused until a live re-reading clears it.
